phase: one controlled D000152 canonical-entrypoint replay; no scaling
hypothesis: The prior non-exact D000152 output may be explained by omitted original CLI entrypoint context, including its threadpool_limits wrapper and single acquisition-process execution.
context_change: Grouped CLI-context restoration; this does not isolate threadpool causality from other entrypoint/process differences.

original_acceptance.criterion: exact original bytes and SHA256; numerical similarity is insufficient

cli.entrypoint_context: experiment_support_modal_v2.main() wraps contract/acquire_phase in threadpool_limits(limits=1); child imports scientific modules itself and acquire_phase writes acquisition.json after the requested design.
cli.parent_guard: Controller imports stdlib only and must not construct a CUDA plate or preimport scientific modules.

execution.prelaunch_acquisition_json: absent on the new remote root; any prelaunch presence is a conflict and must stop
execution.on_second_mismatch: Preserve the new canonical output and receipt/log, stop scaling, do not retag, recompress, overwrite, or claim restoration.

acceptance: A fresh canonical CLI output passes only if it matches the unchanged original D000152 size and SHA256. A second mismatch remains a mismatch and does not promote any gate.
